objects.description: [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has used a command-line tunneler, NACHOCHEESE, to give them shell access to a victim’s machine.(Citation: FireEye APT38 Oct 2018) Additionally, [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has used batch scripts.(Citation: 1 - appv)(Citation: MIcrosoft Mastra npm Compromise JUN 2026) [APT38](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0082) has also executed scripts to launch `cmd.exe` to POST stolen data to actor-controlled domains.(Citation: Microsoft Axios Compromise APR 2026)
